---
title: Code block style, state replaced instead of merged
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      noErrors: default
---

A template replaces the whole state with a dictionary that has only `fill`.
The missing keys must fall back to their defaults.

```{=typst}
#quarto-code-block-style.update((fill: rgb("#fafafa")))
#show block.where(fill: rgb("#fafafa")): it => {
  assert.eq(it.radius, 2pt, message: "radius must fall back to its default")
  counter("cbs-fill").step()
  it
}
```

```python
x = 1
```

```{=typst}
#context assert.eq(counter("cbs-fill").final().first(), 1, message: "expected 1 code block with the fill from quarto-code-block-style")
```
